scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Death
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Bihar
Must be employed as a worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector within Bihar
Age is calculated as of 1st July of any year
Accidents caused by voluntary injury, suicide, or intoxication are excluded
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
